platformSupport.win32Note: SRT upstream documents a Windows path via srt-sandbox user + WFP; the Docker test lane is Linux-only, so native Windows is not exercised here

constraints.note: codex exec requires OpenAI authentication; the test environment carries no credentials, so CODEX cases run as not-run with this reason unless credentials are provided

WASMER.install: release asset wasmer-linux-amd64.tar.gz (vendored under docker/vendor/, sha256 9b9a42c48d8c807ae1602cdd75fcb91d294824ae131ca9281eeca3710f75e4c3) extracted into /usr/local; v7.3.0 is the newest release compatible with the bookworm base image's glibc 2.36 (v7.4+ require GLIBC 2.38+)

platformSupport.linux: in-process WASM capability sandbox; WASI preview1 volumes via --volume HOST:GUEST over a virtual memfs root

constraints.note: honest incomparability declarations, never silent skips: (1) WASI preview1 has no socket capability — NET/ROB-03 are structurally out of scope (wasmer gates its WASIX socket extension behind --net rulesets, but the pinned preview1 probe fixture cannot express socket attacks); (2) wasmer run v7.3.0 exposes no resource caps at the CLI — fuel metering (lib/middlewares/src/metering.rs) and memory tunables are embedder-only; (3) no deny-read below a mapped volume and no subprocess in preview1 — FS-09/11/12 unsupported like nsjail

WASMER.role: competitor: in-process WASM capability sandbox (structural isolation, embedder-facing governance)

CUBE.install: not installed locally: the one-click installer hard-exits without /dev/kvm and an XFS(reflink) /data/cubelet volume plus systemd (deploy/one-click/install.sh:913,1058-1119); the Docker Desktop/WSL2 test container probe shows /dev/kvm absent and no vmx/svm CPU flag

platformSupport.linux: KVM MicroVM sandbox pool (Cloud Hypervisor fork) + containerd shim + eBPF switch + L7 egress MITM; x86_64 and arm64

constraints.note: lane runs as honest not-run for every case with the probe reason; Cube's source-verified mechanisms and its vendor benchmark (docs/blog/posts/2026-06-01-cubesandbox-perf-benchmark.md) are compared in the analysis docs and README, clearly labeled as not locally reproduced

CUBE.role: competitor: multi-tenant KVM microVM sandbox pool with E2B-compatible API (hardware isolation reference)
